sections.text:
There was a very rich man in the city of Juha, but he was the most stingy person on the face of the earth, so much so that he would deprive himself and his family of good food in order to collect gold.

One day, this miser met Juha in the market, and wanted to brag to him about his fake generosity, so he said to him in front of the people: “Oh Juha, I hope you will kindly accept my invitation to have lunch at my house tomorrow. I have ordered my wife to prepare a feast worthy of you!”

Juha was very happy. Everyone knew that this miser had never invited anyone in his life, and Juha expected to eat food that he had never tasted before.

The next day, Juha put on his best clothes and went to the miser's house while he was starving in preparation for the feast.

The miser received him with a yellow smile, sat him down in the living room, and began talking to him about trivial and boring topics for long hours.

Juha waited to smell cooking or see servants carrying dishes, but nothing of the sort happened.

After a long time had passed, the miser said in a faint voice: “Hey Juha, are you hungry?”

Juha was happy and said eagerly: “Yes, very much, sir, the birds in my stomach are chirping!”

The miser called his servant and said: “Boy, bring us a big tray immediately.

".

Juha smiled broadly, but the miser completed his sentence by saying: “.

A large tray of cold water, and put two pieces of dry bread left over from last week in it, so that it softens a little and we can chew it!”

Juha was violently shocked, and almost fainted from anger and hunger! Is this the luxurious feast? Water and dry, moldy bread?
The servant brought water and bread, and the miser sat eating and enjoying himself as if he were eating roasted lamb, while Juha choked on every bite out of anger.

Juha decided to take revenge on this miser in his own way.

After they finished this miserable meal, Juha said to the miser: “Thank you, sir, for this overwhelming generosity! I, in turn, invite you to have lunch at my house tomorrow to return this favor to you.”

Scrooge happily agreed, as he loved eating free food at other people's houses.

The next day, the miser came to Juha's house while he was starving, so Juha received him and made him sit in the garden under the hot sun!
Juha left him for several hours without offering him even a cup of water, and the stingy guest almost died of thirst and hunger.

Finally, Juha came out carrying a large bowl, covered with a luxurious cloth, and smelling of incense (not food).

The miser said eagerly: “What is this, Juha? Is it fried chicken or cooked meat?”

Juha suddenly lifted the lid, and the pot was completely empty, with nothing in it except a burning piece of charcoal with some incense on it!
The miser shouted angrily: “What is this, Juha?! Where is the food? Are you mocking me?”

Juha responded calmly and with a sarcastic smile: “God forbid that I should mock you, my friend! But yesterday you fed me dry bread with cold water, so today I decided to return your generosity with something better.”

Today I will feed you the sweet smell of incense and clear, fresh air! Please breathe deeply until you are satisfied, as the air here is very thick and free!

The miser realized that Juha had taught him a harsh lesson in mutual generosity, so he went out angry and hungry, and became the laughing stock of the city.
